description_en: Sends a comment message by calling SendComment. The comment message is pushed to all online users in the room
description_zh: 调用SendComment发送弹幕消息，该弹幕消息会推送给房间内所有在线人员
kebab_example: aliyun imp send-comment --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE350000T95F --sender-id 620059 --content Hello,_World --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendComment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application, which is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room, which is returned when you call CreateRoom
parameters.help_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the comment message sender. The maximum length is 32 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 弹幕消息发送者的用户ID，最大长度不超过32个字节
parameters.name: sender_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the comment message sender. The maximum length is 128 bytes. If this parameter is left empty, the nickname that the sender registered when entering the room is used. If the registered nickname is also empty, the nickname is displayed as empty
parameters.help_zh: 弹幕消息的发送者昵称，最大长度不得超过128个字节。如果为空，则采用弹幕消息发送者的用户ID在进入房间时注册的昵称。如果对应昵称仍然为空，则显示为空
parameters.name: sender_nick

parameters.help_en: The content of the comment message. The maximum length is 256 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 弹幕消息的内容。最大的长度不超过256个字节
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The extension field in key-value format. The server passes through the extension field information to the client
parameters.help_zh: 扩展字段，key-value形式，服务端会把拓展字段信息一并推送到客户端
parameters.name: extension

Result.description_en: The result of sending the comment message to the room
Result.description_zh: 调用发送房间弹幕消息的返回结果

CommentVO.description_en: The data model of the returned comment message
CommentVO.description_zh: 返回的弹幕消息数据模型

CommentId.description_en: The unique ID of the comment message

Content.description_en: The content of the comment message

CreateAt.description_en: The creation time of the comment message. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
CreateAt.description_zh: 弹幕消息的创建时间，Unix时间戳，单位：毫秒
CreateAt.title_en: 弹幕的创建时间，Unix时间戳，单位：毫秒。
CreateAt.title_zh: 弹幕的创建时间，Unix时间戳，单位：毫秒。

additionalProperties.description_en: 扩展字段key-value键值对中，value的示例值
additionalProperties.description_zh: 扩展字段key-value键值对中，value的示例值

Extension.description_en: The extension field in key-value format. The value is the same as the Extension parameter passed in the request
Extension.description_zh: 扩展字段，key-value形式，其值等同于请求时传递的Extension参数

SenderId.description_en: The user ID of the comment message sender
SenderId.description_zh: 弹幕消息发送者的用户ID

SenderNick.description_en: The nickname of the comment message sender
SenderNick.description_zh: 弹幕消息发送者的昵称

Result.title_en: 调用发送直播间弹幕的返回结果。
Result.title_zh: 调用发送直播间弹幕的返回结果。
